wordCountScope: Direct answer, TLDR bullets, question sections including tables and prompt labels, and customer FAQ text. Excludes navigation, illustrations, source list, CTA and related reading.
checks: no repeated substantive paragraphs across articles

similarity.method: Five-word shingle Jaccard on normalized editorial body; shared navigation, source notes and CTA excluded. A local overlap measure, not a Google score, global plagiarism check or AI detector.

limitations: No guarantee of indexing, rankings, AI citation or classifier outcomes.
No search-engine verdict, independent expert review or real customer benchmark is claimed.
